summary: Frontend-only testing of the redesigned Vertex AI luxury dark-lime landing page (Next.js). Verified page loads without runtime errors, hero heading text, forbidden-content removal (no marquee, no 'AI Signal Engine' badge, no 'Vertex Neural Core' / 'Live · scanning markets' / '98.6%' inside hero chart card), candlestick SVG chart with BUY marker, all data-testids, navbar links + scroll-to-section, mobile hamburger menu, pricing card hrefs & target=_blank, CTA and footer navigation, and responsive layout at 390/768/1920 with no horizontal overflow.

detailed_results.hero_heading: Trade with Intelligence. Win with Vertex AI. (correct)
detailed_results.forbidden_text_check: All 4 forbidden strings absent from home page body
detailed_results.console_errors: Only benign Next.js font preload warnings, no runtime errors

critical_code_review_comments: vertex-landing.tsx is ~675 lines and mixes 8+ components (Navbar, Hero, Stats, Features, HowItWorks, Pricing, CtaBand, Footer, CandleChart) in a single file. Consider splitting into /app/components/landing/*.tsx modules for maintainability (guideline: <700 lines and separation of concerns).

Support nav link uses href='https://t.me/Ayan_sx' with data-testid='nav-link-support' but the Footer also declares id='support' with scroll-mt-24 to be the scroll target — the anchor never actually scrolls to the footer because the Support nav link is external. This is intentional but slightly inconsistent with the other in-page anchors; consider removing id='support' on the footer or making the nav link scroll to it instead of Telegram.

Font preload warnings appear on every page load (5 woff2 files preloaded but not used within a few seconds). Not blocking, but indicates unused Google Font preloads from layout.tsx that could be trimmed.
test_credentials: N/A - landing page requires no auth
context_for_next_testing_agent: All landing-page acceptance criteria in the review request pass. /login and /registration pages render (styled) but their Firebase auth is out of scope. If future work touches vertex-landing.tsx, re-verify: no 'Vertex Neural Core'/'Live · scanning markets'/'AI Signal Engine' text, exactly one occurrence of '98.6%' in the stats row, mobile hamburger, and pricing external hrefs.
